title: Ravnica: Clue Edition: card flavor text

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A wealthy guild of Ravnica, grown richer from wartime loans, with a Church and a bank (Vizkopa Bank).

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A guild that believes protecting Ravnica's wilderness means destroying civilization.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city-plane ruled by guilds, whose true rulers are its people.

entities.name: Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon whose potential victory threatened the planeswalkers' homeworlds.

entities.name: Horance
entities.description: An Urzan general who advises striking automatons' predictability.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: A Boros leader who sends griffins and advises holding to ideals.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: An Azorius figure who orders New Prahv sealed and watches for planeswalker activity.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: An Azorius city that Dovin Baan orders sealed.

entities.name: Brezard Skeinbow
entities.description: A captain of the guard.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who says 'invincible' is just a word and asks a pegasus to give its life to save the world.

entities.name: Mirela
entities.description: An Azorius hussar.

entities.name: Lady Wren
entities.description: A merchant of Keyhole Downs said to run no scam.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: A Ravnican who remarks that many wings haunt the skies.

entities.name: Teysa
entities.description: An Orzhov leader who speaks to Lazav about Boros angels.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A Dimir figure who notes the Rakdos make perfect distractions.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A secret guild.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: A guild that is losing angels to the Gateless Movement and protects those in need.

entities.name: Gateless Movement
entities.description: A movement that draws Boros angels and has marked Nevena for death.

entities.name: Conclave
entities.description: The Selesnya, whose trained falcons scouted Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv and Orzhova.

entities.name: Yolov
entities.description: A Simic bioengineer.

entities.name: Speaker Trifon
entities.description: A speaker who merged life essences.

entities.name: Agosto
entities.description: An Azorius imperator.

entities.name: Kamiz
entities.description: A member of the Obscura who fosters rumors.

entities.name: Urdnan the Wanderer
entities.description: A wanderer who praises bats.

entities.name: Rannon
entities.description: A Vithian holdout.

entities.name: Aszala
entities.description: A member of House Dimir.

entities.name: Urgdar
entities.description: A cyclops philosopher of the Rubblebelt.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A planeswalker who says rot must be burned down.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin with unflinchingly loyal hirelings.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A Rakdos performer who directs stage productions.

entities.name: Harra the Adjudicator
entities.description: An adjudicator who believes the wicked must be purified by fire.

entities.name: Ruba
entities.description: A Rakdos cultist.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: A Sun Empire knight.

entities.name: Cevraya
entities.description: A Golgari shaman.

entities.name: Dars Gostok
entities.description: A Firefist captain.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: A speaker who foretells the End-Raze.

entities.name: Khemses
entities.description: A charioteer.

entities.name: Zija
entities.description: A Simic mutationist.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: A Simic leader who directs the Guardian Project.

entities.name: Yeva
entities.description: Nature's Herald.

entities.name: Nevena
entities.description: A Boros firemane who led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels and is now marked for death by the Gateless.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon, leader of the Izzet.

entities.name: Narbulg Nine Fingers
entities.description: A speaker at a pit fight.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Demon leader of the Rakdos Cult.

entities.name: Leonos
entities.description: A character who issued an eviction edict with skyrunes.

entities.name: Olka
entities.description: A mistmeadow witch.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and Orzhov guildmaster whose power and hatred of the living dead are noted; she warns of the gilded lie.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The former ghostly rulers of the Orzhov, whose fate proves Kaya's power.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A Boros veteran who praises the weight of the Boros signet.

entities.name: Ral
entities.description: A figure whose ambitious project drives Izzet laboratories.

entities.name: Mklthd
entities.description: A homunculus who hated crowds.

entities.name: Ivold
entities.description: A researcher who gasped upon seeing what he thought were geists.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: An event that caused eddies in the aether and created or transformed species.

events.summary: Planeswalkers conjure replicas of old allies as reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed.
events.quote: Planeswalkers conjured replicas of old allies, reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed.

events.summary: Dovin Baan orders New Prahv sealed and planeswalker activity reported.
events.quote: See that no one enters or leaves New Prahv today.

events.summary: Gideon asks a pegasus whether it would give its life to save the world.
events.quote: Would you give your life to save this world?

events.summary: The Conclave's falcons scout Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv and Orzhova.
events.quote: Soaring over Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv, and Orzhova, the Conclave's trained falcons provided critical intelligence.

events.summary: Teysa tells Lazav that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.
events.quote: I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.

events.summary: Firemane Nevena leads the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels and is marked for death by the Gateless.
events.quote: Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels. Now the Gateless have marked her for death.

events.summary: Orzhov vampires distrust their new guildmaster Kaya after the fate of the Obzedat.
events.quote: The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.

events.summary: The Orzhov grow wealthier from exorbitant interest on wartime loans.
events.quote: Wealthier than ever thanks to exorbitant interest on wartime loans, the Orzhov only grew hungrier for more.

events.summary: The arrival of the Planar Bridge creates and transforms species.
events.quote: The arrival of the Planar Bridge caused eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.

relations.note: Described as the new Orzhov guildmaster.
relations.quote: Orzhov vampires look for allies in unlikely places in case their new guildmaster turns on them.

relations.note: Her hatred of the living dead.
relations.quote: The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.

relations.note: The Gateless marked her for death.
relations.quote: Now the Gateless have marked her for death.

relations.note: Teysa speaks to Lazav about Boros losing angels.
relations.quote: I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.
The Gruul believe the best way to protect Ravnica's wilderness is to destroy civilization and all who defend it.

rejected.summary: Angels bring the dawn over a darkened citadel.
rejected.quote: The sky boiled over the citadel, dire and dark. Then the angels brought the dawn.
